messages:
Sam (Finance): Quick question — we just got an invoice from NairaCloud (vendor NC-009). They marked it 'VAT-exempt' and also asked us to gross-up the net amount to cover any Nigerian withholding they think applies. Invoice attached says VAT reg: NG-VAT-87901 and total USD 12,500. Can AP process as-is or do we need extra tax docs?
Priya (Accounts Payable): Do we know where the services were performed? If it's a Nigeria supply, local VAT might apply. Also W-9/W-8 are for US tax forms — not applicable for Nigerian vendors.
Jorge (Vendor Ops): Confirmed — vendor is Nigeria-registered, services performed remotely from Lagos. They sent an email saying customers should "gross up" to account for local tax, but no formal doc.
Marta (Legal): We need proof of tax residency / tax clearance from them to substantiate any exemption. Typical docs: Tax Identification Number (TIN) and a Tax Clearance Certificate or Certificate of Residence (if claiming treaty relief). Ask vendor to reissue invoice with VAT line item and a statement of whether VAT was charged or zero-rated.
TaxBot: Automated check: NG VAT ID format looks valid (NG-VAT-87901). No immediate US withholding requirement flagged for cross-border software/services performed outside US. Still recommend local tax confirmation.
Sam (Finance): OK — action items: (1) Ask NairaCloud to provide TIN + Tax Clearance or certificate of residence, (2) reissue invoice showing VAT amount (or explicitly zero-rated) and the legal basis, (3) confirm whether they expect Redwood to gross-up or they will net their local tax.
Priya (Accounts Payable): I'll hold payment until we have docs. If they insist on gross-up, we'll need Legal sign-off and to run numbers. Please @Jorge escalate to the vendor and request a reissued invoice.
Jorge (Vendor Ops): On it. Drafting message to vendor now: \n```\nHi NairaCloud — thanks for the invoice. To proceed we need: 1) vendor TIN and tax clearance / certificate of residence; 2) a reissued invoice with VAT broken out (or note why VAT is zero); 3) confirmation if you expect Redwood to gross-up amounts for local withholding. Please send within 48h.\n```\nMarta (Legal): If they ask us to gross-up, we need to run a quick calc and check local withholding laws. Likely we won't gross-up routinely — prefer vendor to invoice gross and remit locally. But we'll review if it's material.
Sam (Finance): Thx. Tagging next steps: Priya will block payment, Jorge will chase vendor, Marta will review if gross-up is requested. Ping back here once vendor replies. :thumbsup:
